subject: Onramp + staged migration: proposed timeline and canary plan
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chang <alice@cloudmetrics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T08:01:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: term amendment + dedicated GPU onramp (staged migration overview)

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the renewal discussion last week. Per our call, attached is a concise proposal that folds in the +40 GPU reserved pool you asked for and a 12-month term amendment with graduated throughput SLOs. High level:

- Capacity: add 40x A100-equivalent GPUs as a new reserved pool (named CM-onramp-08).
- Term: 12 months with a mid-term review at month 6 for throughput SLOs and potential scale-up credit.
- Pricing: blended reserved rate for the new pool; I'll loop Rishi for updated quote.
- Cutover approach: staged traffic migration with a 3-stage canary (1%, 20%, 100%) across 3 business days; rollback windows and health gates documented in runbook.

I've attached a short runbook and the term amendment draft (CM_DE20481_term_amendment_v2.pdf, staged_onramp_runbook_v1.md). Please scan for any redlines and confirm who on your side will own acceptance testing and signoff on each canary stage.

Proposed dates (flexible):
- Day 0: Provision pool and validation (infra smoke tests)
- Day 1: Canary 1 (1% traffic) — 4 hour observation window
- Day 2: Canary 2 (20% traffic) — 8 hour observation
- Day 3: Full shift (100%) with monitoring escalation path

Next steps: if this looks good, I'll send a formal amendment and calendar the cutover week.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: CM_DE20481_term_amendment_v2.pdf (application/pdf), staged_onramp_runbook_v1.md (text/markdown)

From: Alice Chang <alice@cloudmetrics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Lee <bob.procurement@cloudmetrics.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: term amendment + dedicated GPU onramp (staged migration overview)

Thanks Ava — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Acceptance testing: our infra lead (internal) will run basic model latency/throughput checks; I will coordinate and provide a single point of contact by EOD Monday.
- SLA gates: can you confirm the exact latency budget for the 20% canary? We need to ensure it aligns with our production SLA.
- Procurement: we will need the formal amendment and an estimate of the prorated charge for Aug (start date) + the reserved monthly charge.

I'll loop Bob for procurement and we should be able to execute quickly if the amendment and prorate look standard.

On the canary windows, please add a health metric that includes p95 latency, error rate, and 5-minute throughput stability.

—Alice
Head of Platform Engineering | CloudMetrics
alice@cloudmetrics.com

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-02T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: term amendment + dedicated GPU onramp (staged migration overview)

Alice / Bob —

Great — thanks for the quick response. Quick answers inline and updated timeline: 

- Latency budget for 20% canary: p95 <= 180ms (model-dependent); if you have tighter budgets for specific routes we can pin per-model thresholds in the canary config.
- Prorate: Rishi, see note below — can you provide the Aug prorate + monthly reserved line item so Bob has what he needs?
- Acceptance owner: noted — Alice will share the infra contact by EOD Mon; we'll add them to the canary test plan.

I've attached a slightly updated runbook with the explicit health checks and the JSON snippets we use for automated gating (see staged_onramp_runbook_v1.md, section 2).

Next actions:
1) Rishi to send amendment and prorate.
2) CloudMetrics to confirm acceptance owner and preferred cutover week (we suggested Aug 10 week but can shift).
3) Stephanie to provision the pool and schedule infra smoke tests once dates are locked.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Ava
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Proposal: term amendment + dedicated GPU onramp (staged migration overview) — pricing/prorate

Bob / Ava —

Attached is the formal term amendment and the prorated charge worksheet (CM_DE20481_term_amendment_v2.pdf). Key commercial points:

- One-time provisioning fee: $4,500 (covers initial queueing and reserved pool carve).
- Monthly reserved fee for 40x GPUs: $62,000/mo (blended A100-equivalent rate, see line 2).
- Aug prorate (assuming Aug 10 start): $20,967.74 (calculated on daily basis).
- Credit: If CloudMetrics scales to >=60 GPUs within the first 6 months we apply a 10% retroactive credit on months 1–3 for the delta.

Please review the attached and ping me with any redlines. Once Bob confirms, I will issue the DocuSign link and mark the provisioning ticket for Stephanie.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions & GTM | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Provisioning and canary ops checklist for CM onramp (Aug 10 week tentative)

Team —

Looping you in to kick off operational work once procurement signs. Summary of operational runbook items (from attached runbook):

1) Provisioning (Stephanie): carve CM-onramp-08 pool (40 GPUs), attach to account CM-20481, verify kernel selection matches models A/B/C.
2) Smoke tests (Monica): run the infra smoke suite (p95 latency, error rate, KV cache warmup) and post results to the ticket. If any gateway errors >0.5% fail the smoke.
3) Canary orchestration (Ava / Monica): use canary controller to shift traffic 1% -> 20% -> 100%. After each stage run the health gate (p95 <= 180ms, error rate < 0.3%, throughput variance < 8% over 10m).
4) Rollback plan: document steps to revert routing (scripted) and list contacts for on-call.

Stephanie — please provision a dev replica by EOD Tue so Monica can run a rehearsal of the canary automation. I put the runbook in the attachment and included the gating JSON.

Thanks all — I'll update the calendar once DocuSign completes.

Ava
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
